stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 clone [-q] [-n] [--bare] [-b <name>] [--depth=<depth>] [--]
                   <repository> [<directory>]

Clone a repository into a new directory.

Options:
    <repository>
        repository path
    -q, --quiet
        display the type of the object
    -n, --no-checkout
        don't checkout HEAD
    --bare
        don't create a working directory
    -b <name>, --branch=<name>
        branch to check out
    --depth=<depth>
        commit depth to check out 
    <directory>
        directory to clone into
